trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 45-50 degrees; depth penetrates roughly 12% of the visible vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency saw-tooth serrations across both lobes; primary peaks reaching 15-20 pixels in height with secondary micro-serrations between major vertices.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature on the outer margins, tapering to sharp, slightly upward-curving distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-intensity white clusters (3-5 pixels in diameter) concentrated on the distal-most tips and along several peak vertices of the trailing edge serrations.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent high-contrast white patch on the far left distal tip; irregular, deep macro-indentation on the right lobe trailing edge approximately 15% inward from the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced jaggedness of the entire trailing edge boundary, exhibiting a higher degree of irregularity than standard median fluke topography.
